description: This file contains CKEditor plugin dialog code for handling 'hiddenfield' form elements, including dialog setup, content handling, and element creation.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: Sets up the dialog content with the selected hidden field element, or restores the real element if necessary.

methods.name: onOk
methods.description: Creates or replaces the hidden input element based on dialog input and inserts it into the editor.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Populates dialog fields with the attributes of the selected element.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Updates the element's attributes based on the dialog input.
